title: About Me
text:
Journey to Chaminade
After graduating high school, I came to Chaminade University to play on the women’s tennis team. The following year, I transferred to Western Wyoming Community College, where I played two years of junior college basketball and earned my associate degree. When my sophomore season ended, I reopened my recruitment and ultimately committed back to Chaminade, where I now play basketball. When I graduate, I’m interested in coaching and as I’m studying data science, I would be interested in applying it to environmental issues or sports analytics.

title: About Me

Fun Facts
Basketball takes up most of my time, but I also love to travel, read, and spend time with friends and family. Some fun facts about me are that I can solve a rubix cube, I know how to do the worm, and I can do magic tricks!
